title: Machine learning segments and classifies adnexal masses on ultrasound across two cohorts
summary: Convolutional-network and radiomics models were compared for segmenting and classifying adnexal masses on transvaginal ultrasound, developed on 577 masses from Imperial College Healthcare and tested externally on 184 masses from Morgagni-Pierantoni Hospital in Italy. On the external test set the best segmentation reached a Dice of 0.85 and the best classification an F1 of 0.83 (AUC 0.90), comparable to published expert subjective assessment. Retrospective preprint; the authors call for prospective evaluation.
